title: Correctional health care program.
bodyText: There is established a correctional health care program within the department. The administrator of the correctional health care program and physicians who provide care to inmates shall be appointed by the director without regard to chapter 76.
bodyHtml: [§353-1.4]  Correctional health care program.  There is established a correctional health care program within the department.  The administrator of the correctional health care program and physicians who provide care to inmates shall be appointed by the director without regard to chapter 76. [L 2022, c 278, pt of §18]
